2.251.13
MapPolygonLayer.MapShapefile
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapPolygonLayer.MapShapefile element specifies a shapefile as the source for the map
polygons (specified by MapPolygon elements) for the parent layer. This element is optional. This
element is ignored if the value of the MapPolygonLayer.MapPolygons element is specified.
The MapPolygonLayer.MapShapefile element cannot be present if either of the following elements
is present:
 MapPolygonLayer.MapSpatialDataSet

 MapPolygonLayer.MapSpatialDataRegion

The MapPolygonLayer.MapShapefile element is of type MapShapefile.
Following is the parent element of the MapPolygonLayer.MapShapefile element.
Parent elements
MapPolygonLayer
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapPolygonLayer.MapShapefile element.
 <xsd:element name="MapShapefile" type="MapShapefileType" minOccurs="0" />
